_doc: Notional Labor-v-CLP two-party figures for NT Legislative Assembly divisions whose final count was NOT Labor v Country Liberal. Rows are [alp_votes, clp_votes]; Mulka 2020 (no CLP stood) and Mulka 2024 (no ALP stood) can carry nothing. Provenance and verification trail: .build/map/src/nt/notional-adjudication.md. Do not edit by hand without re-running the check in build_nt_common (the frame's non-classic-with-both-majors set must equal this file's division set exactly).

nt16.credit: Alternative two-party preferred counts undertaken post-election by the NT Electoral Commission (published in Antony Green's NT2016 summary of results, abc.net.au · ABC 'Prepared by Antony Green' pdf)

nt20.credit: Estimated two-party count by Antony Green, published on his election analysis blog and carried in each seat's result table (Wikipedia's per-seat boxes cite the same source)

nt24.credit: Alternative two-party preferred counts per Antony Green's post-election summary (abc.net.au '2024 Northern Territory Election – Summary of Results', prepared by Antony Green, December 2024)
